posts.author: _jasonwei
posts.name: Jason Wei
posts.text: After an amazing year at Meta’s TBD lab, I am very excited to join Mercor as Chief Scientist. Data will shape the next frontier as more companies train AI models than ever before. Mercor is incredible and I look forward to building the future with Brendan, Adarsh, and team!
posts.quoted: We are excited to bring on @_jasonwei as Chief Scientist at @mercor. Jason is known for pioneering work on reasoning and agents at Google Brain, OpenAI, and Meta. He also created several benchmarks adopted across the industry: SimpleQA, a widely-used pretraining benchmark,
